1. Scope
This proce-
dure applies to all contracted operators.
Figure 1 Incident Flow
13
OPERATIONS MANUAL 2024
Operators must log each incident within 24 hours.
Exceptions are permitted only when the duty manager approves the delay.
2. Communication
The control room must notify the field supervisor immediately.
Continued on next page
14
OPERATIONS MANUAL 2024
The field supervisor may escalate high-risk incidents to the response lead.
3. Retention
The platform stores each incident log for 90 days.
Archived logs remain available for audit requests.
